_note: Estimates only. OpenAI and Portkey do not report energy or water per request. Edit these assumptions as better data appears.

price_usd_per_million_tokens._note: Assumed list prices for gpt-6-luna (not published to the course). Replace with real prices if known.

energy_wh_per_1k_tokens._note: Weighted tokens = output + 0.25 x uncached input + 0.05 x cached input. Range spans public per-prompt estimates (Google 2025 ~0.24 Wh per median Gemini prompt; OpenAI 2025 ~0.34 Wh per average ChatGPT query) up to heavier reasoning workloads.

water_l_per_kwh._note: On-site data-center cooling plus water used to generate the electricity (Li et al., 'Making AI Less Thirsty', 2023, range of US averages).
